title: Fix StateSync broadcasting hidden state to all players
description: StateSync with full_state is broadcast to ALL players, leaking hidden/private zones in imperfect-info games. Any player can trigger by sending wrong state_hash. Fix: (a) send StateSync only to requesting player, (b) filter state per-player visibility.
close_reason: Changed StateSync from Broadcast to Reply — only sent to requesting player, preventing hidden state leaks in imperfect-info games.
